resources.string: Android calls this permission “Physical activity”. Passo uses it only to read your phone’s step counter, and your steps never leave the phone. Allow notifications too, and today’s count shows in the notification that keeps counting running.
The permission was turned down. You can allow “Physical activity” in the app’s settings.
This phone has no step counter
Passo counts steps only with the phone’s own step counter sensor, and this device doesn’t have one. There is nothing Passo can count here.
You can close the app. Counting goes on in the background, and starts again by itself after a restart.
